text_block_list.name: Troubled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, that's such a lifesaver~! Thanks, 
Dantsu! Much appreciated~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, no problem at all. Returning a few 
books to the library is nothing. Let me 
know if you ever need anything else!

Today, like any other day, Dants Flame was 
taking on favor after favor. While she 
didn't seem to mind at all, as her 
Trainer, I—
choice_data_list: I wonder if it'll be okay...

text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to call out, I 
stopped. I felt an intense gaze coming 
from down the hallway, behind Dantsu 
Flame.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: *staaaaaaaaare.*

Mayano Top Gun, Hishi Miracle, and several 
other Umamusume are secretly watching 
Dantsu Flame.

Although it caught my attention, I decided 
to stay quiet for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Dants-san... thank you very much. I was in 
trouble because I couldn't go buy those 
limited-edition coffee beans.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, don't worry about it! It's 
really no big deal, okay?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... Please allow me to repay you in some 
way. If there is anything I can do—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'll think about it then. ...Oh, 
right. I have a few other errands to run 
today, so... see you later, Cafe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: You took on other tasks too...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Dantsu-san's Trainer. Yeah. Taking on 
favors endlessly..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And yet, she's always helping others... 
without ever accepting... any thanks in 
return.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Now that it's come to this... I must look 
for... a chance to repay them..."

"...Could it be? I wonder. Those girls 
keeping an eye on things nearby the other 
day..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll get ready for training 
right away. For now, let's head to the 
gym—

While talking about training, I felt that 
gaze on me again. When I checked to see...

"...The Manhattan Cafes are multiplying. 
It seems they were indeed looking for an 
opportunity to show their gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Oh no... I forgot the wrist weights I 
was going to use for today's training back 
at the dorm...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll go get it right away! I'm so sorry, 
Trainer. Please wait just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaahhh~! Wait, wait, wait!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry~ ...Wait, Dantsu-chan, are 
you already about to take off running~?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back!! See you laâ

She rambled on about how she had to go 
train right away, saying there was no 
time.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
U-Um? Is there an issue with the 
reservation? W-What should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, right here! I actually have a great 
idea for that~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
One at a time, everyone~! First, Maya gets 
to thank them!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Since you're in a hurry, how about 
having the fastest Umamusume go fetch 
it...?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wha, what? Why is everyone... Trainer, 
what is this...!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okay, it's a race to Dantsu-san's room for 
all of us! Maya's not gonna lose to 
anyone!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I am sorry, but I cannot step aside. I 
have a debt of gratitude to repay."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... Maybe I should wait for the next 
one. But I don't know when another chance 
will come along... Ah, forget it, let's do 
this!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's wrong with everyone... 
Eeeeeek?! Trainer, what are you laughing 
at... wait, everyone, what are you doing 
all of a sudden—whoa?!

Everyone who wanted to say thanks dashed 
forward all at once, leaving Dants Flame 
completely blasted by the wind pressure of 
their gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ask someone...? It's something I forgot, 
so I should properly retrieve it myself. 
Besides, to rely on others for something 
like this—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I'm one of the people who was 
saved by 'something like that,' you 
know~?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When my remedial class ran late and I said 
I'd miss the show I wanted to watch, you 
ran all the way to record it for me, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Maya's trainer did the same! 
They went and took photos of the air show 
that Maya couldn't attend because of a 
race!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“...... I wish to thank you. Please... 
don't... hold back......”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, wh... what? C-Could it be... you all 
came here just for that?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I don't do this, I won't have 
a chance to pay you back~."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...At this rate... it looks like it'll 
turn into a brawl. Could you choose... who 
should go?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya! Maya's the best pick, right? Pick 
Maya, Dantsu-san!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I always tell you... not 
to worry about it..."

Dantsu Flame cannot hide her surprise. 
However, once she grasps the situation, 
she gives an embarrassed smile.
